applicationFee.note: Biological Sciences department explicitly does not offer fee waivers. Central graduate application fee $75.

english.note: IELTS Academic; no IELTS One Skill Retake or TOEFL MyBest/superscores. PTE 53 also listed. Scores valid two years, with continuously-enrolled US-study exception. MOI letters not accepted. Exemptions include approved-country citizenship or qualifying education in an approved country; UNT IELI Level 6 also accepted.

documents: Transcripts for all undergraduate and graduate study
Statement of purpose, maximum 2 pages, covering goals, motivation, preparation, research and faculty fit
Three signed recommendation letters on university/company letterhead
Major Professor Form uploaded by agreeing advisor; entered as fourth recommender slot
TA application form if seeking teaching assistantship
requirements.note: Bachelor’s with 24 life-science/related hours including 12 advanced. Undergraduate GPA 3.0 overall and 3.2 last 60 hours; prior graduate GPA 3.4. Research-based master’s desirable, not required. Faculty-major-professor agreement required for Biology; BMB rotations are a separate degree route. Late/incomplete applications denied.

funding.note: Admission does not guarantee support. Students may self-fund or hold competitive TA/RA appointments. TA consideration requires its separate application form; discuss support with major professor. No current stipend or universal guarantee verified.
